title: Theta-Phi coordinate research
description: Exploratory Theta-Phi coordinate research by Grant Boudreaux (first author) and Daniel Fredriksen (second author), beginning with Grant Boudreaux's proposal. Repository setup only; no verified mathematical result, novelty, or Riemann-hypothesis consequence is established. Planned verification uses LLM review and Lean certification under the Quantyra process; neither has been completed. The collaboration requires a public implementation repository. The original proposal remains private pending a source-sharing decision; reuse licensing and archival publication remain pending.
